name: HashiCorp Vault
description: Bounded Vault KV v1/v2, diagnostics and transit HTTP operations using externally managed protected tokens.

permissions.description: HTTP to an explicit Vault origin; externally managed token via protected RuntimeConnection or exact VAULT_TOKEN secret binding. Secret data/decrypted plaintext are intentional sensitive outputs. KV writes/deletes/destroy and transit crypto require exact confirmation. No token generation/login, dynamic credentials, key export/create, init/unseal, retries, listeners or filesystem.
